★ Request
Display Nishino Flower
Outfit: Summer Uniform

■ Stage Direction
1 second of silence at start
(The words that gave me courage...)

Trainer was just sharing your honest thoughts with me,
but I... I was so happy that I misunderstood... and forced it on you...

“It's scary to think you might become a burden to someone... I get that.
But I don't think sharing your feelings is imposing on them.”

I pull a boxed lunch out of the cooler bag.
It's the thank-you I hadn't been able to give Nishino Flower until now.

I-Is that so? ...Then I went and jumped to
conclusions again... Th-That's so embarrassing...!

The last thing I want is to waste
your time because of me...

A boxed lunch...? F-For me?
You made this for me, Trainer?!

“After all, it's how we come to understand one another.
Letting people know who you are is important.”
(Those words gave me courage, too...)
(The words Trainer said to me while I was crying...)

We talked about what Nishino Flower likes, dislikes, and wants to try,
spending a delightful lunch hour together.
“You gave me courage.”

(I can't cause trouble for Trainer...
I have to make sure I don't get in their way!)
...I'm so happy! So, so very happy...!

Um... you had plans to get lunch with the senior trainers,
right? But then I ended up giving you that boxed lunch, so...

An idea strikes me from the time I've spent with Nishino Flower.
I don't know if it'll work, but I'll put my heart into it and try.

An air of wanting to avoid burdening me hangs about her.
Right from the start, I could sense a subtle distance between us...

The summer training camp begins. I hope to use this opportunity
to get Nishino Flower to open her heart to me, but—
"Oh Flower-chan, you sound just like we used to back in the day, don't you?"
"Hehe..."
(I couldn't run the way I wanted to... right until the very end...)

Nishino Flower's running lacked stability. Weighed down by the
thought that she had to do her best, she seemed to be spinning her wheels...

"Didn't you receive that very courage
from your Trainer, Flower-chan?"

"Knowing you, even if something was bothering you,
you probably wouldn't bring it up on your own, would you?"
With the same kindness she had shown me all this time—

I'll do my best to grow as much as I can during this camp!
Um, of course, practicing on my own is totally fine too...!

Ah... ehehe. You're right! Both the lunchbox you made for me
and the one I made... are packed full of feelings.
...Um, Trainer?

"Sorry for calling during your training camp.
We hadn't heard from you lately, so we got a little worried..."

So... will you put lots of my favorite foods
in mine next time too, Trainer?
...Mom?
...Understand... each other...
Huh?

I... have been worrying this whole time.
Thinking that I caused trouble for you, Trainer.

...U-Um, Trainer!!
Before we go have lunch... p-please listen to me!
"I want to scout you."

"Why don't you try expressing your feelings more honestly?
I'm sure your Trainer would want you to do that, too."

Since we're at summer camp, I want her to have a fulfilling time.
—What can I possibly do to make that happen?

"It takes courage, but you can do it, Flower. After all,
your mother and I received that courage from you in the first place."
U-Um, you see... the thing is...
...I wonder if I can say it properly...?

I tell her from the bottom of my heart that I had already finished eating
when I was invited, and that I was genuinely happy to receive her lunchbox.
I'm... s-so sorry... I...

"Don't push yourself too hard" or "Let's just have fun."
Words like that might end up cornering her even more.

We eat our boxed lunches together while looking out at the sea.
Nishino Flower gazes affectionately at the slightly burnt tamagoyaki.
...Mom, Dad, thank you so much!

Next time, I'd like to... trade lunches with you.
I'll fill it with lots of things you like, Trainer.

And... even though I try so hard not to cause any trouble
for you, Trainer... it just never goes well...

Hah, hah... phew... whew!
Thank you for your hard work, Trainer!
Hah, hah... I'm going again...!
Ah... hello? Dad, Mom? Is something wrong?
